prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 extreme close-up beauty portrait of an adult East Asian woman with straight black hair and loose natural strands across her face. She has dark brown almond-shaped eyes, a small mole beneath her left eye, soft eyeliner, defined lashes, and natural pink lip tint. Frame her face through both hands forming a heart shape directly in front of the lens. She gives one playful wink, keeps the other eye softly open, and has a subtle playful pursed-lip expression. Use soft 5200K diffused beauty light, realistic natural skin texture, sharp eye focus, shallow depth of field, and a pale unobtrusive background. No text, logo, watermark, or sexualized framing.
